text: I'd say traffic is the main cause, because the number of cars keeps growing and many of them are old and produce a lot of exhaust fumes. Factories and power stations also contribute, especially in cities that depend on coal for heating. On top of that, construction creates a lot of dust. In my opinion, the most serious factor is transport, as it affects people's daily lives directly and could be reduced by better public transport.

tips.en: On top of that adds another factor informally.
tips.kk: On top of that тағы бір факторды ауызекі қосады.
tips.ru: On top of that добавляет ещё один фактор разговорно.
tips.example: On top of that, construction creates a lot of dust

tips.en: Passive with could be focuses on the solution.
tips.kk: Could be ырықсыз етісі шешімге назар аударады.
tips.ru: Passive с could be фокусируется на решении.
tips.example: could be reduced by better public transport

questions.followUp: Which one is the most serious?
questions.question: What do you think are the main causes of pollution in cities?

text: I think so, provided the system is fair. Fines make people think twice before throwing rubbish on the street or dumping waste, because they hit their wallets. However, punishment alone isn't enough. There should also be enough bins and recycling points, otherwise people have no alternative. For companies, the fines should be high enough to make it cheaper to comply with the rules than to ignore them.

tips.en: Think twice is a natural idiom for deterring.
tips.kk: Think twice — тежеу үшін табиғи идиома.
tips.ru: Think twice — естественная идиома для сдерживания.
tips.example: Fines make people think twice before throwing rubbish on the street

tips.en: However … alone shows depth of thought.

questions.question: Should people who pollute the environment be fined?

text: Practical activities work best, in my view. When children plant trees, sort rubbish or take part in a clean-up like the one I described, they remember the experience much more than a lecture. Schools could also run competitions between classes, for example to see who produces less waste. Having said that, parents have a role as well, because children copy what they see at home.

tips.en: In my view at the end sounds natural.
tips.kk: Сөйлем соңындағы in my view табиғи естіледі.
tips.ru: In my view в конце предложения звучит естественно.
tips.example: Practical activities work best, in my view

tips.en: Having said that adds a complement.
tips.example: Having said that, parents have a role as well

questions.followUp: Is it better to teach it at home?
questions.question: How can schools teach children to care about the environment?

text: I'm cautiously optimistic. Young people are far more aware of climate issues than previous generations, and many companies now realise that sustainability attracts customers. Technology is also helping, with cheaper solar panels and electric cars. However, change won't happen automatically. It requires strong policies and consistent public pressure, otherwise short-term profit may still win over long-term benefits. That is what gives me real hope for the next generation.

tips.en: Otherwise shows the result of a missing condition.
tips.kk: Otherwise шарт болмаған жағдайдағы салдарды көрсетеді.
tips.example: otherwise short-term profit may still win over long-term benefits
